title: Raku Workshop SAT 9/12
evidence_sentence: The studio-events page lists a dated Raku firing workshop on September 12 with firing credit passes for pottery pieces.
summary: A hands-on raku firing workshop at Nate Winter Studios in Windham, Maine. Participants bring bisqueware and glaze their pieces while learning firing and reduction techniques. Firing credit passes range from $60–$150, or $30 to observe.
how_to_join: Register online; full payment required at registration
